description: Provenance map from the labels of the imported disassembly to the semantic names this reconstruction gave them. It replaces the inline '; was:' comments, which sat in two different places -- on the label line for data and on the first body line for procedures -- and recorded only a symbol's immediate predecessor rather than its origin.

source.origin: IDA Pro 7.6 SP1 disassembly of Flicky (UE) [!]
source.label_policy: Every label, equate and macro defined in flicky.s at the import commit. A name the reconstruction did not change appears with original equal to current.
